save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model and optimizer checkpoint to a directory at a given training step
resume_from_checkpoint: resume a PyTorch model and optimizer from the latest checkpoint file in a directory
clean_up_checkpoints: clean up old checkpoint files in a directory keeping only the last N checkpoints
compute_learning_rate_decay: compute a log-linearly interpolated learning rate with optional warmup delay for a given training step
compute_psnr_ssim: compute PSNR and SSIM image quality metrics between predicted and target tensors with optional masking
